verdict.rationale: Statsig is a SaaS platform that ingests customer event and user data, so a training-data opt-out is a fair privacy question for it. However, the evidence pack contains no documented control, policy, or setting that prevents customer data from being used to train AI models. Related items, such as Warehouse Native analysis in your own warehouse and environment isolation, are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
